claim_001.label: SUPPORTED
claim_001.text: Redirect responses no longer contain themselves within their own redirect history chains.

evidence.note: The change assigns resp.history before appending resp to the history list.

claim_001.rationale: The new ordering prevents a response from appearing inside its own history.

claim_002.label: SUPPORTED
claim_002.text: The change was introduced to prevent self-references in Response redirect history.

evidence.note: The commit title explicitly states the self-reference prevention goal.

claim_002.rationale: The stated purpose in the commit message directly matches the behavior.

claim_003.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_003.text: The change was primarily introduced to improve redirect processing performance.
claim_003.rationale: No performance objective appears in the commit or diff.

claim_004.label: UNSUPPORTED
claim_004.text: The change adds support for a new redirect protocol.
claim_004.rationale: The change only affects redirect history bookkeeping.
